# AGENTS.md

## Project Overview

A minimal Next.js 15 App Router demo. Renders a hello-world page. Deploys via `vercel deploy`.

## Coding Standards

- TypeScript strict mode on. No `any` in exported types.
- Prettier for formatting. No overrides.

## Key Commands

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev              # NOTE: this command is referenced but does not exist in package.json
pnpm build
pnpm test
```
